research.needs: every gate in PROTOCOL.md; not eligible today
research.purpose: the single bounded research run whose adapter is evaluated once on the frozen independent held-out tasks
research.rows: rows of effective-keep templates from rights-included sources, minus rows and templates removed by the human row review, exactly as derived by `axbench_tr.tr03_gates.research_manifest`; nothing is inferred or corrected

resource.adapter: discard-only; hashed; never evaluated, copied or used as initialization
resource.needs: nothing is proposed; any use needs a new protocol amendment, clearance and owner authorization
resource.purpose: discard-only sustained-throughput, thermal and validation-overhead measurement at full corpus scale; no quality claim
resource.status: withdrawn from the proposal at the technical lead's instruction (PR #15 comment 7235630804): human review, not compute, is the bottleneck; not to be built, cleared or run; kept here only so the earlier plan numbers keep their meaning

never_used: AXBENCH v0.1 train or validation (EXP-010 evaluation data)
any held-out evaluation task of EXP-TR03

hyperparameters.base: fresh pinned Qwen3-1.7B; no probe, smoke, EXP-010 or resource-arm adapter and no optimizer state is loaded

inherits.meaning: model pins, packages, Python, hyperparameters and memory limits are copied unchanged from the TR02 config so that the rates measured in EXP-TR02 apply; tests/test_tr03_plan.py compares them

limits_of_this_file: a proposal; nothing here is measured except the rates copied from the EXP-TR02 record

monitor.thermal: any statement other than 'No thermal warning level has been recorded', 'No performance warning level has been recorded' or 'No CPU power status has been recorded' stops the run; unparseable output stops the run

rates.full_tokens_per_s_note: probe on the 20 longest rows (1,625); smoke windows were 1,642.1 to 1,692.3
rates.thermal_allowance_note: conservative allowance for a run about 15 times longer than the 2.5 minute smoke; not measured

schedule.candidate: the adapter after the last optimizer update is the only candidate; no checkpoint selection
schedule.eval_points_after_updates: floor(k * U / 4) for k = 1..4, plus one evaluation before the first update
schedule.eval_rows: the fixed diagnostic validation rows (teacher-forced loss only)
schedule.final_full_validation: all eligible validation rows once after the last update (teacher-forced loss only)
schedule.snapshots: adapter saved at each eval point for post-mortem; hash recorded; never evaluated, selected or resumed from

status: proposed; prepared; not executed; not approved; no clearance exists; no training is authorized; immutable once reviewed (change = new version)
